overrides.text: The van stood at the head of the Long Quay with its horses in and its lamps lit against the grey. It was slate blue. Mace was on the box and Nairn beside him, with Ruddock and Tibb and Stiles behind, and Pike on the tailboard where he always sat, and Rhea standing at the horses' heads with her slate on her belt. Anwen's bag was already up. Anwen was not.
